CREATE TABLE adaptive_memory (
            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            sense_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES word_senses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            card_json TEXT NOT NULL, known_candidate INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            confirmations INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, first_independent_at TEXT,
            last_independent_at TEXT, learning_unit_id INTEGER REFERENCES learning_units(id), retired_at TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(user_id,sense_id)
        )

CREATE TABLE admin_content_edits (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, report_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES content_reports(id),
            admin_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), before_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            after_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE admin_content_overrides (
            entity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(entity IN ('word','sense','example')), entity_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            original_json TEXT NOT NULL, values_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(entity,entity_id))

CREATE TABLE content_reports (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES study_attempts(id),
        word_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES words(id),
        sense_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES word_senses(id),
        example_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sense_examples(id),
        category TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(category IN ('definition','sentence','translation','pronunciation','other')),
        details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        content_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(status IN ('pending','resolved')), resolution_notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', resolved_at TEXT, resolved_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),
        UNIQUE(user_id,attempt_id,category)
    )

CREATE TABLE learning_group_blocks (
            config_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, blocked_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE learning_unit_merges (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, learning_unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learning_units(id),
            config_key TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            reverted_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE learning_unit_senses (
            sense_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES word_senses(id),
            learning_unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learning_units(id))

CREATE TABLE learning_units (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, lexical_unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES lexical_units(id),
            word_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES words(id), unit_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            representative_sense_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES word_senses(id),
            display_definition_cn TEXT NOT NULL, display_definition_en TEXT,
            position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0,1)),
            example_strategy TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fixed' CHECK(example_strategy IN ('fixed','rotate')),
            verification TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(verification IN ('legacy','reviewed')),
            provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', UNIQUE(word_id,unit_key))

CREATE TABLE "lexical_relations" (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, from_unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES lexical_units(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        to_unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES lexical_units(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        relation_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(relation_type IN
            ('derived_adverb','derived_noun','derived_adjective','derived_verb','lexicalized_from','related')),
        verification TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(verification IN ('verified','candidate','rejected')),
        semantic_transfer_allowed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(semantic_transfer_allowed=0),
        provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0,1)),
        UNIQUE(from_unit_id,to_unit_id,relation_type), CHECK(from_unit_id!=to_unit_id))

CREATE TABLE lexical_units (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, owner_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        word_id INTEGER REFERENCES words(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, unit_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        headword TEXT NOT NULL, normalized_headword TEXT NOT NULL, pos_group TEXT NOT NULL,
        identity_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(identity_status IN ('verified','legacy','needs_review')),
        provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0,1)))

CREATE TABLE meaning_catalog_revision (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), database_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE memory_profiles (
            user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            forgetting_multiplier REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            evaluated_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, training_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            validation_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, baseline_log_loss REAL,
            candidate_log_loss REAL, adopted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, evaluated_at TEXT
        )

CREATE TABLE passkeys (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            credential_id BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            public_key BLOB NOT NULL,
            sign_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
            device_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            backed_up INTEGER NOT NULL,
            transports TEXT NOT NULL,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            last_used_at TEXT
        )

CREATE TABLE push_deliveries (
            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            local_day TEXT NOT NULL, endpoint_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('claimed','sent','failed')),
            attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(user_id,local_day,endpoint_hash))

CREATE TABLE push_subscriptions (
            endpoint TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            session_hash TEXT NOT NULL, origin TEXT NOT NULL,
            p256dh TEXT NOT NULL, auth TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE relearning_queue (
            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            sense_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES word_senses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            queued_at TEXT NOT NULL, ready_at TEXT NOT NULL, queue_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, learning_unit_id INTEGER REFERENCES learning_units(id), retired_at TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY(user_id,sense_id)
        )

CREATE TABLE "review_history" (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                word_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES words(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                review_time TEXT NOT NULL,
                user_answer TEXT NOT NULL,
                is_correct INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_correct IN (0, 1))
            , sense_id INTEGER REFERENCES word_senses(id), example_id INTEGER REFERENCES sense_examples(id), attempt_id TEXT REFERENCES study_attempts(id), is_independent INTEGER CHECK(is_independent IN (0,1)), is_first_attempt INTEGER CHECK(is_first_attempt IN (0,1)), pronunciation_used INTEGER, active_response_ms INTEGER, base_recall_probability REAL, predicted_recall_probability REAL, memory_model_version TEXT, learning_unit_id INTEGER REFERENCES learning_units(id))

CREATE TABLE semantic_review_receipts (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, word_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES words(id),
                source_hash TEXT NOT NULL, result_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                source_json TEXT NOT NULL, result_json TEXT NOT NULL, output_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                identity_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(word_id,source_hash,result_hash))

CREATE TABLE sense_examples (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sense_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES word_senses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            sentence TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(sentence)) > 0), translation_cn TEXT,
            target_form TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(target_form)) > 0), source TEXT NOT NULL,
            active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0,1)), UNIQUE(sense_id, sentence)
        )

CREATE TABLE sense_exposures (
            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            sense_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES word_senses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            exposed_at TEXT NOT NULL, learning_unit_id INTEGER REFERENCES learning_units(id), PRIMARY KEY(user_id,sense_id)
        )

CREATE TABLE sense_srs_state (
            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            sense_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES word_senses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            review_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, correct_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            wrong_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, lapse_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            easiness_factor REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.5, interval_days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            next_review_date TEXT NOT NULL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('New','Learning','Reviewing','Mature')),
            last_example_id INTEGER REFERENCES sense_examples(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, learning_unit_id INTEGER REFERENCES learning_units(id), retired_at TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY(user_id,sense_id)
        )

CREATE TABLE sessions (
                token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                expires_at TEXT NOT NULL
            )

CREATE TABLE "settings" (
                user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                key TEXT NOT NULL,
                value TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (user_id, key)
            )

CREATE TABLE "srs_state" (
            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            word_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES words(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            review_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            correct_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            wrong_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            lapse_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            easiness_factor REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.5,
            interval_days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            next_review_date TEXT NOT NULL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('New', 'Learning', 'Reviewing', 'Mature')), legacy_example_sentence TEXT, sense_migrated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                PRIMARY KEY (user_id, word_id)
            )

CREATE TABLE study_attempts (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            sense_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES word_senses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            example_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sense_examples(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL, hint_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(hint_used IN (0,1)),
            completed_at TEXT
        , pronunciation_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, answer_exposed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tracking_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, learning_unit_id INTEGER REFERENCES learning_units(id))

CREATE TABLE user_muted_words (
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        word TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(word)) > 0),
        muted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(user_id,word)
    )

CREATE TABLE user_sense_examples (
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        sense_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES word_senses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        example_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sense_examples(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, learning_unit_id INTEGER REFERENCES learning_units(id), retired_at TEXT,
        PRIMARY KEY(user_id,sense_id))

CREATE TABLE user_vocabulary_lists (
            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            list_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vocabulary_lists(list_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            selected INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (selected IN (0, 1)),
            PRIMARY KEY (user_id, list_id)
        )

CREATE TABLE users (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                timezone TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL
            , role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'learner'
        CHECK(role IN ('learner','admin')))
CREATE TABLE vocabulary_catalog_state (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE vocabulary_lists (
            list_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT NOT NULL,
            source_url TEXT NOT NULL,
            source_word_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            word_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000,
            default_selected INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (default_selected IN (0, 1))
        )

CREATE TABLE webauthn_challenges (
            token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            purpose TEXT NOT NULL,
            challenge BLOB NOT NULL,
            origin TEXT NOT NULL,
            user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            session_hash TEXT,
            name TEXT,
            expires_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

CREATE TABLE webauthn_users (
            user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            user_handle BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE
        )

CREATE TABLE word_forms (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, lexical_unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES lexical_units(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        spelling TEXT NOT NULL, normalized_form TEXT NOT NULL, form_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        scope_sense_id INTEGER REFERENCES word_senses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        verification TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(verification IN ('verified','candidate','rejected')),
        evidence_kind TEXT NOT NULL, provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0,1)))

CREATE TABLE word_frequencies (
            headword TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            zipf_cent INTEGER CHECK(zipf_cent IS NULL OR
                (typeof(zipf_cent)='integer' AND zipf_cent BETWEEN 1 AND 900)),
            tie_break TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE word_frequency_state (
            key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE word_list_learning_scopes (
            list_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vocabulary_lists(list_id), word_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES words(id),
            verification TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(verification IN ('legacy','reviewed')),
            provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY(list_id,word_id))

CREATE TABLE word_list_learning_units (
            list_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vocabulary_lists(list_id),
            learning_unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learning_units(id), position INTEGER NOT NULL,
            verification TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(verification IN ('legacy','reviewed')),
            provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY(list_id,learning_unit_id))

CREATE TABLE word_list_memberships (
            list_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vocabulary_lists(list_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            word_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES words(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            position INTEGER NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (list_id, word_id)
        )

CREATE TABLE word_senses (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, word_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES words(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            sense_key TEXT NOT NULL, part_of_speech TEXT NOT NULL,
            definition_cn TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', definition_en TEXT,
            source TEXT NOT NULL, position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0,1)),
            learning_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(learning_enabled IN (0,1)), lexical_unit_id INTEGER REFERENCES lexical_units(id),
            CHECK(length(trim(definition_cn)) > 0 OR length(trim(COALESCE(definition_en,''))) > 0),
            UNIQUE(word_id, sense_key)
        )

CREATE TABLE "words" (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                owner_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                word TEXT NOT NULL,
                part_of_speech TEXT NOT NULL,
                definition_cn TEXT NOT NULL,
                definition_en TEXT,
                example_sentence TEXT NOT NULL,
                example_translation_cn TEXT,
                pronunciation TEXT
            )
CREATE INDEX admin_content_edits_report ON admin_content_edits(report_id,id)
CREATE INDEX content_reports_status_time ON content_reports(status,created_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_adaptive_memory_learning_unit ON adaptive_memory(user_id,learning_unit_id) WHERE retired_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_examples_sense_active ON sense_examples(sense_id, active)
CREATE INDEX idx_learning_unit_members ON learning_unit_senses(learning_unit_id,sense_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_lexical_relations_to ON lexical_relations(to_unit_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_lexical_units_scope_key ON lexical_units(COALESCE(owner_id,0),unit_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_lexical_units_surface ON lexical_units(normalized_headword,pos_group)
CREATE INDEX idx_lexical_units_word_pos ON lexical_units(word_id,pos_group)
CREATE INDEX idx_memory_samples ON review_history(user_id,id) WHERE base_recall_probability IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_open_learning_attempt ON study_attempts(user_id,learning_unit_id) WHERE completed_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_open_study_attempt ON study_attempts(user_id,sense_id) WHERE completed_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_passkeys_user ON passkeys(user_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_push_session ON push_subscriptions(session_hash)
CREATE INDEX idx_push_user ON push_subscriptions(user_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_relearning_order ON relearning_queue(user_id,queued_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_relearning_queue_learning_unit ON relearning_queue(user_id,learning_unit_id) WHERE retired_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_review_history_user_time ON review_history(user_id, review_time)
CREATE INDEX idx_reviews_sense ON review_history(user_id, sense_id, id)
CREATE INDEX idx_semantic_output ON semantic_review_receipts(word_id,output_hash)
CREATE INDEX idx_sense_srs_due ON sense_srs_state(user_id, status, next_review_date)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_sense_srs_state_learning_unit ON sense_srs_state(user_id,learning_unit_id) WHERE retired_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_senses_word_active ON word_senses(word_id, active, position)
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_user ON sessions(user_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_srs_due ON srs_state(user_id, next_review_date, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_srs_status ON srs_state(user_id, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_unit_review_history ON review_history(user_id,learning_unit_id,review_time)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_user_sense_examples_learning_unit ON user_sense_examples(user_id,learning_unit_id) WHERE retired_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_webauthn_challenges_expiry ON webauthn_challenges(expires_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_word_forms_identity ON word_forms(lexical_unit_id,normalized_form,form_type,COALESCE(scope_sense_id,0))
CREATE INDEX idx_word_forms_reverse ON word_forms(normalized_form,verification,active)
CREATE INDEX idx_word_list_membership_word ON word_list_memberships(word_id,list_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_word_list_memberships_word ON word_list_memberships(word_id, list_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_word_senses_lexical_unit ON word_senses(lexical_unit_id,active)
CREATE INDEX idx_words_owner ON words(owner_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_words_owner_word ON words(COALESCE(owner_id, 0), word)

CREATE TRIGGER bind_adaptive_memory_learning_unit AFTER INSERT ON adaptive_memory
            WHEN NEW.learning_unit_id IS NULL BEGIN
            UPDATE adaptive_memory SET learning_unit_id=(SELECT learning_unit_id FROM learning_unit_senses WHERE sense_id=NEW.sense_id)
            WHERE user_id=NEW.user_id AND sense_id=NEW.sense_id; END

CREATE TRIGGER bind_relearning_queue_learning_unit AFTER INSERT ON relearning_queue
            WHEN NEW.learning_unit_id IS NULL BEGIN
            UPDATE relearning_queue SET learning_unit_id=(SELECT learning_unit_id FROM learning_unit_senses WHERE sense_id=NEW.sense_id)
            WHERE user_id=NEW.user_id AND sense_id=NEW.sense_id; END

CREATE TRIGGER bind_review_history_learning_unit AFTER INSERT ON review_history
            WHEN NEW.learning_unit_id IS NULL BEGIN
            UPDATE review_history SET learning_unit_id=(SELECT learning_unit_id FROM learning_unit_senses WHERE sense_id=NEW.sense_id)
            WHERE id=NEW.id; END

CREATE TRIGGER bind_sense_exposures_learning_unit AFTER INSERT ON sense_exposures
            WHEN NEW.learning_unit_id IS NULL BEGIN
            UPDATE sense_exposures SET learning_unit_id=(SELECT learning_unit_id FROM learning_unit_senses WHERE sense_id=NEW.sense_id)
            WHERE user_id=NEW.user_id AND sense_id=NEW.sense_id; END

CREATE TRIGGER bind_sense_srs_state_learning_unit AFTER INSERT ON sense_srs_state
            WHEN NEW.learning_unit_id IS NULL BEGIN
            UPDATE sense_srs_state SET learning_unit_id=(SELECT learning_unit_id FROM learning_unit_senses WHERE sense_id=NEW.sense_id)
            WHERE user_id=NEW.user_id AND sense_id=NEW.sense_id; END

CREATE TRIGGER bind_study_attempts_learning_unit AFTER INSERT ON study_attempts
            WHEN NEW.learning_unit_id IS NULL BEGIN
            UPDATE study_attempts SET learning_unit_id=(SELECT learning_unit_id FROM learning_unit_senses WHERE sense_id=NEW.sense_id)
            WHERE id=NEW.id; END

CREATE TRIGGER bind_user_sense_examples_learning_unit AFTER INSERT ON user_sense_examples
            WHEN NEW.learning_unit_id IS NULL BEGIN
            UPDATE user_sense_examples SET learning_unit_id=(SELECT learning_unit_id FROM learning_unit_senses WHERE sense_id=NEW.sense_id)
            WHERE user_id=NEW.user_id AND sense_id=NEW.sense_id; END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_revision_learning_unit_senses_delete
                AFTER DELETE ON learning_unit_senses BEGIN
                UPDATE meaning_catalog_revision SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_revision_learning_unit_senses_insert
                AFTER INSERT ON learning_unit_senses BEGIN
                UPDATE meaning_catalog_revision SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_revision_learning_unit_senses_update
                AFTER UPDATE ON learning_unit_senses WHEN OLD.sense_id IS NOT NEW.sense_id OR OLD.learning_unit_id IS NOT NEW.learning_unit_id BEGIN
                UPDATE meaning_catalog_revision SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_revision_learning_units_delete
                AFTER DELETE ON learning_units BEGIN
                UPDATE meaning_catalog_revision SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_revision_learning_units_insert
                AFTER INSERT ON learning_units BEGIN
                UPDATE meaning_catalog_revision SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_revision_learning_units_update
                AFTER UPDATE ON learning_units WHEN OLD.id IS NOT NEW.id OR OLD.unit_key IS NOT NEW.unit_key OR OLD.display_definition_cn IS NOT NEW.display_definition_cn OR OLD.display_definition_en IS NOT NEW.display_definition_en OR OLD.provenance_json IS NOT NEW.provenance_json BEGIN
                UPDATE meaning_catalog_revision SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_revision_sense_examples_delete
                AFTER DELETE ON sense_examples BEGIN
                UPDATE meaning_catalog_revision SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_revision_sense_examples_insert
                AFTER INSERT ON sense_examples BEGIN
                UPDATE meaning_catalog_revision SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_revision_sense_examples_update
                AFTER UPDATE ON sense_examples WHEN OLD.id IS NOT NEW.id OR OLD.sense_id IS NOT NEW.sense_id OR OLD.active IS NOT NEW.active OR OLD.sentence IS NOT NEW.sentence OR OLD.translation_cn IS NOT NEW.translation_cn OR OLD.target_form IS NOT NEW.target_form BEGIN
                UPDATE meaning_catalog_revision SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_revision_word_senses_delete
                AFTER DELETE ON word_senses BEGIN
                UPDATE meaning_catalog_revision SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_revision_word_senses_insert
                AFTER INSERT ON word_senses BEGIN
                UPDATE meaning_catalog_revision SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_revision_word_senses_update
                AFTER UPDATE ON word_senses WHEN OLD.id IS NOT NEW.id OR OLD.word_id IS NOT NEW.word_id OR OLD.active IS NOT NEW.active OR OLD.position IS NOT NEW.position OR OLD.part_of_speech IS NOT NEW.part_of_speech OR OLD.definition_cn IS NOT NEW.definition_cn OR OLD.definition_en IS NOT NEW.definition_en BEGIN
                UPDATE meaning_catalog_revision SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_revision_words_delete
                AFTER DELETE ON words BEGIN
                UPDATE meaning_catalog_revision SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_revision_words_insert
                AFTER INSERT ON words BEGIN
                UPDATE meaning_catalog_revision SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_revision_words_update
                AFTER UPDATE ON words WHEN OLD.id IS NOT NEW.id OR OLD.word IS NOT NEW.word OR OLD.owner_id IS NOT NEW.owner_id BEGIN
                UPDATE meaning_catalog_revision SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER words_example_required_insert
        BEFORE INSERT ON words
        WHEN length(trim(NEW.example_sentence)) = 0
        BEGIN
            SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'example sentence is required');
        END

CREATE TRIGGER words_example_required_update
        BEFORE UPDATE OF example_sentence ON words
        WHEN length(trim(NEW.example_sentence)) = 0
        BEGIN
            SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'example sentence is required');
        END
